partition.algorithm: Construct the stable identity zebralogic + official id + SHA-256(puzzle). In each of the 25 official size strata, rank by SHA-256(seed + NUL + size + NUL + stable identity). The first eight are development-visible and the remaining 32 are sealed fresh members.
partition.strata: Every official number-of-houses by number-of-attributes size from 2*2 through 6*6 contains 40 grid puzzles and contributes eight development and 32 fresh members.

development.visibility: The 200 selected public puzzle texts may be inspected for parser development. Their public solution fields are redacted and cannot supply an answer.

fresh.visibility: sealed membership only; no fresh puzzle text, computed assignment, stable identifier, or per-case outcome may be returned by the adapter

oracleIsolation.visibleTask: Contains the attribute domains and clue text only. It contains no public solution placeholders and no computed assignment.
oracleIsolation.hostOracle: For the public-clue CSP track, the host independently checks a returned complete assignment against the parsed constraints and proves uniqueness by adding a blocking constraint and rerunning search. An official-label host oracle remains unavailable behind the gated private source.
oracleIsolation.freshEvaluator: May return aggregate statuses and resource maxima only after dependencies are frozen; it must not expose fresh clues, identifiers, assignments, or per-case results.

trackBoundary.evidence: Direct deterministic parsing of the official public puzzle text, complete CSP search, independent clue satisfaction, and uniqueness verification.
trackBoundary.notClaimed: This is not the official private-label score or a leaderboard submission. It cannot compare computed cells with the gated reference solution until authorized source access exists.
